summary: Frontend-only verification that the CRA runtime-error overlay ('Uncaught runtime errors: ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications') no longer appears on /customer-invoice-overview and other data-heavy pages. Logged in as admin, exercised heavy interactions: multiple viewport resizes (1920->1280->1440->1920 etc.), opened distributor combobox, opened customers multi-select and typed 'Brian', scrolled table horizontally, and briefly visited /sku-performance and /account-volume-grid with resizes. At every checkpoint: iframe#webpack-dev-server-client-overlay = not present, 'Uncaught runtime errors' text = 0, page.on('pageerror') ResizeObserver entries = 0, console 'ResizeObserver loop' entries = 0. Only console errors observed were unrelated 401/400 resource loads (auth-guarded endpoints during initial nav), no uncaught JS errors. index.js swallow logic verified in place (capturing 'error' + 'unhandledrejection' listeners filter ResizeObserver loop).
critical_code_review_comments: index.js filter uses capturing listener with stopImmediatePropagation+preventDefault only for messages containing 'ResizeObserver loop' — narrow and safe. Good pattern; no changes recommended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRA overlay for ResizeObserver loop is fully suppressed. If new page-errors appear later that are NOT ResizeObserver loop, they will still surface (filter is narrow by design).
rca of the issue: Original overlay was benign ResizeObserver loop notice fired by browser when a ResizeObserver callback triggers another layout in the same frame. Fix: index.js registers a capturing window 'error' listener that calls stopImmediatePropagation+preventDefault when message contains 'ResizeObserver loop', preventing CRA's webpack-dev-server overlay from receiving it; also handles unhandledrejection for the same. Combined with sm:w-64 / sm:w-96 fixed widths on CIO filter bar reducing layout feedback. Verified end-to-end: 0 overlay occurrences after heavy stress.
